argv: Outside sources wait until each licence
ops.body: - [owner] Outside sources wait until each licence is confirmed at its source (the owner, Nov 17): the Smithsonian's outdoor sculpture survey (about 32,000; CC0 and coordinates unconfirmed), the National Register's map layer and NPS National Natural Landmarks (likely public domain), state historical-marker programs (Texas, Virginia, Pennsylvania; attribution likely), city public-art inventories (New York, San Francisco, Buffalo; open terms, a schema each), the Forest Service's recreation sites (CC BY 4.0). Decision 0198 (numbered 0197 in the intro above before main took that number). The research notes: research_notes/Chronicles attraction data sources/ in the session's workspace.
